question: Does a country-specific logit time trend improve on last observation carried forward when 2023 resistance is held out, especially in the lowest-completeness eligible stratum?

data_contract.entity_weighting: equal weight per eligible indicator-entity row
data_contract.sample_size_weighting: not used because the frozen public snapshot contains rates but not a comparable denominator for every entity-year

completeness_strata.definition: observed years across 2016-2023, including the required holdout-presence indicator but never its value

last_observation_carried_forward.definition: predict the 2023 percentage with the most recent observed value from 2016-2022

country_specific_logit_time_trend.definition: clip each training percentage divided by 100 to [0.005, 0.995], fit ordinary least squares to logit(value) against calendar year within one indicator-entity row, extrapolate to 2023, then apply the inverse logit and multiply by 100

uncertainty.reported_contrast: country_logit absolute error minus locf absolute error
uncertainty.decision_use: descriptive only; it does not create or relax an acceptance threshold

controls.positive: a synthetic exact logit-linear series must be extrapolated to 2023 within 1e-10 percentage points
controls.negative: a constant synthetic series must give identical locf and country_logit predictions within 1e-10 percentage points

future_candidate_gate.required_primary_comparisons: a future candidate must have strictly lower equal-entity weighted absolute error than both frozen baselines for each indicator overall and in that indicator's partial stratum
future_candidate_gate.required_calibration_comparisons: a future candidate's absolute calibration bias must not exceed the lower of the two baseline absolute biases by more than 2.0 percentage points on the same required slices

interpretation_boundaries: The evaluation is conditional on entities that reported a 2023 value and had at least three observed training years.
It does not estimate performance for non-reporting entities or identify a 245-entity global mean.
The rates are not individual-level outcomes and do not support patient, prescribing, or treatment recommendations.
No candidate model, causal claim, clinical action, pathogen manipulation, or solved-frontier claim is produced.
